# agentloom
**English** | 简体中文
**One source of truth for skills, MCP servers and memory across AI coding agents.**

agentloom keeps the state you would otherwise duplicate per harness — reusable skills, MCP server
de

finitions, and the memories that make an agent useful — in a single local directory, and renders
it

into whatever each harness expects. Today that means **DeepSeek Harness ⇄ Codex**, with the
per-harn
ess differences kept in explicit overlay files rather than in divergent copies.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Where to find it
| What you are looking for | Where it is |
| This repository | `github.com/Nowyousee1/agentloom` — search GitHub for **`agentloom`** or the top

ics `agent-skills`, `shared-memory`, `mcp`, `codex`, `deepseek-harness` |
| CLI package | `npm i -g
@nowyousee1/agentloom`; the installed command is `agentloom`. The GitHub release tarball remains ava

ilable as an offline fallback |
| DSH plugin | `npm i -g dsh-agentloom`, or install the GitHub relea

se tarball |
| npm registry names | `@nowyousee1/agentloom` and `dsh-agentloom` |
| Inside DeepSeek
Harness | plugin manager → `dsh-agentloom`; plugin entry `include:dsh-agentloom`; MCP tools are the

7 `loom_*` tools |
| Inside Codex | `codex plugin list` → `agentloom@agentloom`; MCP server name `ag

entloom` |
| On this machine | source of truth `~/.agentloom`, config `~/.agentloom/hub.json`, gener

ated Codex plugin `~/.agentloom/build/codex-marketplace` |
| Health check | `agentloom doctor` — one
row per wire, `✖` exits non-zero |
## Why

- **Skills drift.** The same procedure gets copied into two harnesses and then fixed in only one.
ag

entloom authors it once: shared `core`, plus a `variants/<target>.md` for the parts that really
diff

er (tool names, shell idioms).
- **Memory does not cross.** A decision recorded in one harness is in

visible to the other. agentloom
keeps a writable shared store and mirrors it into the places each ha

rness actually reads, so the
knowledge shows up without the model having to remember to call a tool.
- **MCP definitions get retyped.** agentloom owns the definitions once and emits per-harness views,
without copying credentials into artifacts that get committed.

## What works, and how it was verified
| Capability | Mechanism | Evidence |
| One skill source, two harnesses | `core` + `variants/<target>.md`, rendered per target | a DSH-onl

y marker appears in the DSH render and is absent from the Codex render |
| DSH sees the skills | lin
ks in `~/.dsh/skills` | `agentloom doctor` reports `links 2/2`; links repair themselves after a hub

rename |
| Codex sees the skills | Codex marketplace plugin | `codex plugin list` shows `agentloom@a

gentloom installed, enabled` |
| Both harnesses read the memory | `memory/shared.md` + AGENTS.md blo

ck + MCP | a memory written from DSH is listed by a `codex exec` call to `loom_memory_list` |
| Code
x sees memory without calling a tool | marked block in `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` | a Codex run with *no t

ools allowed* quotes the preferences from that block |
| MCP definitions are shared | `mcp/servers.j
son` → per-harness `.mcp.json` | the Codex plugin ships only the agentloom bridge, never third-party

tokens |
| Idempotent | every write is guarded | `agentloom sync` twice: second run reports `unchan
ged` for every link and block |
## Commands
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`agentloom doctor` is the first thing to run when something looks wrong; it checks the Node version,
hub config, DSH links, Codex skill inventory, the MCP bridge and its runtime copy, the Codex plugin
version versus its cache, the AGENTS.md mirror block, index freshness, leftover legacy directories
and any DSH compatibility patches.

## The DeepSeek Harness plugin

`packages/dsh-plugin` is a Cordis plugin. It injects a system-prompt section containing the shared
m

emories plus the memory entries the host's `AGENTS.md` budget currently truncates away, and
register

s `loom_status`, `loom_sync`, `loom_memory_search`, `loom_memory_list`, `loom_memory_add`
and `loom_

skill_list`. Its `Config` schema exposes `enabled`, `limit`, `chars` and `staleWarning`, so
injectio
n behaviour is adjustable from the settings page instead of through environment variables.

The injection budget is `"auto"`: agentloom reads `agent-instructions.maxBytes` from the profile's
`

cordis.patch.yml`. "Invisible" therefore means invisible to *this* harness, not to a hard-coded
gues

rdis.patch.yml`. "Invisible" therefore means invisible to *this* harness, not to a hard-coded
guess.
## The MCP server
`packages/cli/mcp/server.mjs` is a dependency-free stdio JSON-RPC server. Codex (or any MCP client)

ages/cli/mcp/server.mjs` is a dependency-free stdio JSON-RPC server. Codex (or any MCP client)
gets:
| Tool | Mutates | Purpose |
| `loom_memory_search` | no | search the index, defaulting to entries the current context cannot see

|
| `loom_memory_list` | no | list the shared (both-sides-writable) memories |
| `loom_memory_add`

| yes | add or update a shared memory by title |
| `loom_skill_list` | no | list source skills with

their targets |
| `loom_skill_show` | no | show one skill's core and variants |

### 已验证能力
| 能力 | 机制 | 证据 |

| 一份技能真源，两端使用 | `core` + 按端渲染的 variants | DSH 专属标记只出现在 DSH 产物中 |
| DSH 自动看到技能 | `~/.dsh/skills` 链接 |

`agentloom doctor` 报告 `links 2/2` |
| Codex 自动看到技能 | Codex marketplace 插件 | `codex plugin list` 显示

`agentloom@agentloom` |
| 两端读写同一份记忆 | `shared.md` + AGENTS.md 标记块 + MCP | 任一端写入后，另一端可检索到 |
| Codex 不

调用工具也能看到关键记忆 | `AGENTS.md` 标记块 | 禁止工具调用的 Codex 会话仍能引用该内容 |
| MCP 定义可共享 | `servers.json` → 各端配置 | 插件产

物不包含第三方凭据 |
| 同步幂等 | 每次写入都有锚点与所有权检查 | 连续执行两次 `sync`，第二次全部为 `unchanged` |
